notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS. Wants hosted API first to validate quality/perf, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable cost & residency. Key ask: EU-only data residency and a documented multi-region routing policy. Shorthand notes from calls:
- "Host API good fit for initial ship" (quote from Head of Platform)
- P50 target: <=150ms for short chat; P95 target: <300ms ideally in EU primary region
- Throughput: embeddings batch ~200/sec, chat concurrency ~60 concurrent users peak
- Concern: user base in APAC ~8% -> need clear cost/latency tradeoff if routing outside EU
- Legal: needs residency attestation + subprocessor list before Dedicated procurement
- Tech: prefer open-model variants; okay with Redwood-verified quantized variants to reduce cost
- Willing to sign 12mo commit if Dedicated baseline meets latency and residency checks
- "More docs on failover costs pls" — procurement comment
technical_requirements: Latency SLOs: p50 <=150ms (EU), p95 <=300ms preferred. Embedding throughput 200 req/s with batch sizes 16-32. Must support VPC peering and KMS-managed keys. KV/prefix caching required for chat to meet SLOs. Multi-region routing: primary EU region with optional warm fallback to +1 region (costed). Audit logs exported to customer's SIEM (Splunk) for 1 year.
pricing_feedback: Procurement asked for three price bands: hosted volume tier, 12mo dedicated baseline (4 GPU pool), and burst capacity pricing. Very cost sensitive — prefer blended rate that includes multi-region egress cap. Wants demo numbers converted to $/1000 tokens and $/embedding for board review.
demo_feedback: UX: liked streaming and function-calling demo. SE noted model quality parity vs current in-house embeddings for their retrieval stacks. Observed: p95 latency spikes during synthetic burst; SE recommended tuning batching and enabling KV prefix caching. Asked for test plan to reproduce p95 spikes in dedicated staging.
